sources.title: LFM2-1.2B-Extract - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: LFM2-1.2B-Extract is optimized for extracting structured data (JSON, XML, YAML) from unstructured documents. It handles complex nested schemas and multi-field extraction with high accuracy.

sources.title: LFM2 1.2B Extract - slm.expert
sources.snippet: Task-specific 1.2B text model from Liquid AI that extracts structured JSON, XML, or YAML from unstructured documents in nine languages, matching or beating far larger generalists like Gemma 3 27B on extraction quality.

sources.title: LFM2 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: At the 1B scale, LFM2-1.2B improves over Granite-4.0-1B and Qwen3-1.7B by 2.3-2.8× on prefill and 1.7-2.2× on decode across both context lengths. Gemma-3-1B is the strongest 1B-class baseline in terms of raw throughput; however, LFM2-1.2B attains 0.75 − 0.9× of its prefill throughput, while offering slightly higher 1K decode throughput ...
